description: Walk confidently in every room by checking your posture first #confidence
transcript: Confidence begins long before you open your mouth. Confidence with me starts with my posture. I always have tight abs. I always have my head up, my chin up. I am always moving and flow. The way that I walk, my body moves in tandem. I look like I'm dancing when I walk into rooms. Confidence starts with your posture. Always check your posture.
